title: Clean signed MSIX install on each architecture
Upgrade preserves package-local settings and library
Uninstall and reinstall behavior matches release policy
Second launch activates the existing window and player
Packaged holmdel links validate, route, and do not report untrusted IDs
Two live stations play and update Windows media controls
Dead stream exhausts bounded retries and remains manually recoverable
Network loss and restoration obey resume setting and user intent
Sleep and wake obey resume setting and never override Pause or Stop
Headset, Bluetooth, and dock route changes pause safely
Long-running stream survives title changes without false stall recovery
KEXP and Brookdale titles, artwork, media controls, and history agree
Radio Browser reporting sends only explicit enabled play events
Keyboard navigation, focus restoration, Escape, and dialogs work
Narrator names and state announcements are useful and non-spamming
High contrast, light/dark, 200 percent text, Acrylic fallback, and inactive window remain legible
